items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: It was the same thing like Baby Dodge would come to my house. My father and their father and mother and all good friends.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear young Lorenzo or any of them, his father said they came from Mexico or were ever in Mexico?

I never did know where they came from. All I knew I was a kid in Basin, Lewis, and they were living on Main Street. I used to go to their house. It was the same thing like Baby Dodge would come to my house. My father and their father and mother and all good friends.
Who was Baby Dodge playing with when you took Emma away from you?
